title: DeepSeek banned from U.S. federal civilian agencies under new DHS order
reason: A DHS order banning DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies is a significant regulatory action against a major AI lab, backed by a primary Federal Register source despite only one aggregator.

title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
reason: OpenAI acquisition confirmed by two sources, a clearly publishable M&A move expanding a frontier lab into life sciences.

sources.summary: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.

OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.
